inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, collar_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (inner_radius, collar_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (inner_radius, 0))

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (leg_length_long, 0), (leg_length_long, leg_thickness),
                     (leg_thickness, leg_thickness), (leg_thickness, leg_length_short),
                     (0, leg_length_short), close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_depth)

solid_body = p.part

# Hole on short leg
hole_x = leg_thickness / 2
hole_y = leg_length_short - hole_offset_from_end
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(hole_x, hole_y, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, bracket_depth + 2)

pocket_x = leg_length_long - pocket_offset_from_end - pocket_width / 2
pocket_y = leg_thickness / 2
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(pocket_x, pocket_y, bracket_depth - pocket_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_height, pocket_depth)

# Chamfer on outer corner edge at (leg_thickness, leg_thickness)
z_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
corner_edge = None
for e in z_edges:
    c = e.center()
    if abs(c.X - leg_thickness) < 0.1 and abs(c.Y - leg_thickness) < 0.1:
        corner_edge = e
        break

    solid_body = chamfer([corner_edge], chamfer_size)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = fillet(top_face.edges(), fillet_radius)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

    angle = i * rib_spacing
    solid_body = solid_body + Rot(0, 0, angle) * rib
